item.description:
### Search and Ask - Ask a question across all your meetings from search (the Ask button, or start with "?"). Answers cite the moments they come from, play from there, and can be saved as a note. - Your recent searches and questions show under the empty search field, and each Ask conversation is saved as a Markdown file. Clear the history in Settings → Search by Meaning.
### Recording - After you press Stop, the menu bar shows the meeting being saved, transcribed and summarised, one step at a time. - Mute works while Unicorder is holding the start of a call, and stopping a muted recording no longer leaves your Mac's microphones muted. - Pressing Record on a held call no longer holds up the recording for a moment.
### Transcription - Transcribing shows its steps (Transcribe, Vocabulary, Speakers) with progress and time left, now including speaker identification. - A model download is only mentioned when there is one. - Model downloads in Settings show Find, Download and Prepare, so a finished download that is still getting ready no longer looks stuck. - Cloud transcription is only given the misheard spellings of this meeting's invitees.
### Feedback - Send Feedback attaches the diagnostics by itself when Outlook is your mail app. With other mail apps, the diagnostics file is shown in Finder, ready to drag in.
### Fixes - Choosing This Is Me on your own page in People no longer crashes the app, and People opens faster. - Choosing a storage folder in iCloud Drive no longer hangs the app for minutes. - Slides and summaries are saved in the right place when the meeting is renamed or moved to the Bin while they are being made. - Meeting files are saved in a way a crash can't leave half-written. - Help → Privacy describes exactly what Unicorder does.

### Installing - The installer window shows where to drag Unicorder, with an arrow to Applications. - Opened straight from the installer, Unicorder asks to be dragged to Applications first. - Once installed, Unicorder offers to eject the installer and move it to the Bin.
### Transcription - When a transcription has to download its model first, the meeting page shows how far the download has got, with the time left. - Cancelling a transcription stops at once, even while a model downloads in Settings. - Model downloads in Settings keep showing their progress when you come back to them, and can be cancelled. - The live transcript starts as soon as its model finishes downloading, during the recording.
### Summaries - Summaries with Apple Intelligence work on macOS 27: long meetings are split up again, and ordinary meetings are refused far less often.
### Look and feel - During the trial, Pro features are marked "Pro trial", with the days left in the tooltip. - Tidier spacing in the toolbar, around Settings in the sidebar and in the window for choosing a storage folder.
